review.source: Source drawings and five packed atlases were visually reviewed on dark and light backgrounds; the native game renderer selects each action in both facings with the separate ball.
review.notes: J.28 cell55 references and all42 authored drawings confirm an adult human woman with fair warm skin, dark eyes, abundant vivid electric-blue waves in a high ponytail with loose side locks, a small silver fish-shaped hairpin and navy/electric-blue Venom Delta kit. The hairpin has no canon-assigned anatomical side; no other feature blocks safe body mirroring.

assembly.operation: Isolate alpha-connected figures from original imagegen sheets; uniformly scale each source part to a shared 142px maximum pose height; place into a transparent 7x6, 192px cell source at baseline184. No pose is drawn, duplicated, interpolated, or mirrored.
